newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian Hansapank gets Munich OTC quote.
newsitem.headline: Estonian Hansapank gets Munich OTC quote.

text.p: Estonian leading bank Hansapank on Tuesday said its shares have started being traded on the Munich over-the-counter (OTC) market.
The Munich quote follows the start of trade in Hansapank on the Frankfurt OTC. It is already quoted in Tallinn and Helsinki.
Hansapank said in a statement that the Munich quote, on the Bayerische Boerse, was made at the suggestion of brokers Baaber Wertpapiere, who would also be the market makers in the stock.
"There has been increasing interest by international investors in Hansapank and this is also shown by the quotation on one of Europe's largest bourses, Frankfurt," Hansapank said.
Hanspank said that quotations on international bourses were positive for investors as it increased liquidity and gave a more realistic value for the shares.
Hansapank is the Estonian bank market leader and has a subsidiary in neighbouring Latvia.
